chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
He passed by the dead bodies of the Khawarij on the day of Nahrawan: Woe unto you! You have been harmed by him who deceived you.

key_terms.النَّهْرَوَانِ: Nahrawan, the location of the battle between Ali and the Khawarij
key_terms.الْخَوَارِجِ: The Khawarij, a early Islamic sect known for their rebellion against Ali

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say to the Khawarij after the Battle of Nahrawan?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) addresses the Khawarij not merely as defeated enemies but as victims of their own ideological deception, a theme central to his critique of their literalist extremism. This declaration underscores the Shia understanding that their deviation stemmed from being misled by self-appointed guides who distorted religious truth, leading to their self-destruction at Nahrawan.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 323. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, passed by the dead bodies of the Khārijites on the day of the battle of Nahrawān and
said: Woe unto you! You have been harmed by him who deceived you.
